name: Florida assessment title strings, preliminary 2026 edition
description: Unvalidated algorithm-label counts for public 2026 assessment records in 66 counties. These are not verified ownership, beneficial-owner or buyer statistics.
scope: Combined 66 Florida counties, excluding Jackson. DOR use 001 single family and 004 condominium records. Two disjoint just-value bands. Mixed 56 final-folder and 10 preliminary NAL files. Classification validation failed. No county or parcel results.
update_policy: Versioned preliminary edition. Review source status and method quarterly. A later roll or classifier requires a new version and fresh calculation.

changelog.change: Published combined 66-county descriptive algorithm counts with failed holdout metrics and missing-value exclusions disclosed. No validated ownership estimate is claimed.
